summary: DevSecOps Engineer with 3.5+ years of experience designing secure, scalable cloud-native infrastructure and CI/CD platforms. Skilled in Kubernetes, Docker, GitOps, ArgoCD, Terraform, AWS, GCP, and Azure, with expertise in DevSecOps automation, container security, and infrastructure as code. Proven track record in startup environments driving platform reliability, security compliance, and deployment automation across microservices architectures.

experiences.title: DevSecOps Engineer
responsibilities: Established an internal CI/CD workflow with automated vulnerability scans, reducing vulnerabilities by 80%. Integrated SAST, DAST, IaC scanning, and Snyk & Gitlab into CI/CD pipelines for vulnerability assessment and application security; performed vulnerability management by assigning tickets to developers with defined SLAs upon vulnerability detection, reducing vulnerabilities by 80%.

Designed and maintained GitLab CI/CD pipelines with continuous integration using Kaniko, Docker, and BuildKit for automated containerization, image builds, and deployment workflows, including secure Minikube + BuildKit environments for non-privileged container builds.

Lead GitLab self-managed to SaaS migration (subgroup imports, CI/CD variable migration, GKE runner integration) and container registry migrations from JFrog Artifactory to Docker Hub and GitLab Container Registry across multiple microservices.
Implemented security compliance and governance controls including IAM authorization policies using Vanta Audits and automated Slack notifications tied to Gitlab security scan triggers.
Implemented alerting through Slack for CI/CD pipelines and conducted Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for post-incident reviews.

Contributing to ArgoCD deployment automation and Kubernetes upgrade activities across GKE/EKS environments; automating AWS cloud infrastructure workflows using GitLab CI/CD, Crossplane, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

Collaborating and communicating with development teams on Agile SDLC workflows and code review; leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and prompt engineering for workflow automation, continuous improvement, and technical documentation.

Worked in startup environments with cross-functional responsibilities, including developing and maintaining Airbyte connectors (both low-code and Python-based), packaging connectors as Docker images, managing versioning and continuous deployment pipelines, maintaining and enhancing the Dragster deployment flow while following established microservice architecture patterns, deploying and managing APIs with ArgoCD using a consistent microservice deployment strategy, and packaging applications using Helm Charts to ensure standardized, scalable, and reliable deployments across environments.
Continuously evaluated and improved security processes, tools, and practices to adapt to evolving threats and business needs.

experiences.title: DevOps Engineer
responsibilities: Led execution on 6 Real-Time Projects: Mainland hellomainland.com, encompassing 1851franchise.com, stachcow.com, estatenvy.com, room1903.com, smw.com, and Schedula.in.

Developed and implemented a continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) infrastructure pipeline for a new application, reducing deployment time and scalability by 70% and increasing team productivity by 45%.

Set up and maintained testing, development, staging, and production environments, ensuring seamless application deployment and improving overall system reliability through containerization of microservices including load balancing and clustering.

Collaborative with development teams to problem-solve, debug, and continuously improve software applications solutions, migrations and troubleshooting resulting in a 55% increase in user satisfaction and a 80% increase in revenue through proper teamwork using tools like PowerShell and VMware.
Maintained system documentation and provided trained new team members, improving onboarding time by 60%.
Monitored system logs and identified potential issues, resulting in a 50% reduction in system downtime and improved system performance.
